title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.19605v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-output inference in large language models suffers from severe KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. While KV cache quantization alleviates this issue, low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) severely degrades model accuracy. Recent mixed-precision key-cache quantization methods mitigate this degradation by allocating higher precision to important key channels, but estimate channel saliency using only key statistics. Through attention logit perturbation analysis at the RoPE channel-pair level, we show that quantization errors in channel pairs with large query--key pair-norm products contribute significantly to logit variation. Based on this insight, we propose PN-Mix, a mixed-precision key-cache quantization method for RoPE-based decoder-only LLMs, which allocates higher precision to salient channel pairs identified once during the prefill stage and reused throughout decoding. translated_title: PN-Mix：面向高效长输出大语言模型推理的配对范数引导混合精度键缓存量化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的长输出推理受到严重的KV缓存内存与带宽瓶颈的制约。虽然KV缓存量化可以缓解这一问题，但低比特量化（例如2比特）会严重损害模型精度。近期的混合精度键缓存量化方法通过为重要的键通道分配更高精度来缓解这种精度下降，但其仅利用键自身的统计信息来估计通道显著性。通过在RoPE通道对层面进行注意力logit扰动分析，我们证明了在查询-键配对范数乘积较大的通道对中，量化误差对logit变化有显著影响。基于这一洞察，我们提出了PN-Mix，一种面向基于RoPE的仅解码器（decoder-only）大语言模型的混合精度键缓存量化方法，该方法为显著通道对分配更高精度，这些通道对在预填充阶段仅识别一次，并在整个解码过程中复用。在标准推理、代码生成和AIME基准……
tldr: PN-Mix通过RoPE通道对层面的查询-键配对范数分析识别量化敏感的键缓存通道对，并在预填充阶段一次性识别、解码全程复用，为其分配更高精度，从而实现高效且低精度损失的长输出大语言模型推理。
en_tdlr: PN-Mix identifies quantization-sensitive key cache channel pairs via RoPE channel-pair query-key pair-norm analysis, allocating them higher precision (identified once at prefill and reused during decoding) to enable efficient long-output LLM inference with minimal accuracy degradation.
